name: Yellow Line BRT direct and feeder services (planned)
operator: Sindh Mass Transit Authority (World Bank Karachi Mobility Project)

sources.title: Environmental Impact Assessment, BRT Yellow Line, Vol 1 (19-03-2024)
sources.publisher: Sindh Mass Transit Authority (copy hosted by Urban Resource Centre)

routes.name: Numaish - Korangi Model Park

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Direct Service 01: from Numaish via Korangi Road, Jam Sadiq Bridge, Brookes Chowrangi and Landhi Road; ends near Korangi Model Park. 20 km, of which 11 km on the BRT corridor. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Korangi Road - Chungi Stop

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Direct Service 02: starts from Korangi Road and ends at Chungi Stop. 9 km, of which 2.4 km on the corridor. The EIA gives no more detail on the start point, so 'Korangi Road' is a road, not a precise stop. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Siddiq Akbar Road - Ibrahim Hyderi

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Direct Service 04: from Siddiq Akbar Road via Syed Ammar Bukhari Road, Korangi Road and Coast Guard Chowrangi; ends near the Ibrahim Hyderi area. 13 km, of which 2.2 km on the corridor. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Syed Ammar Bukhari Road - 51/C Graveyard

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Direct Service 05: from Syed Ammar Bukhari Road towards FH Enterprises, Primo Chemicals, National Refinery Road, joins the trunk at Vita Chowrangi, leaves at Indus Chowrangi, Korangi No. 5 road, Qabrastan Road past Alakram Pakwan Center; ends at 51/C Graveyard. 11 km, of which 2.72 km on the corridor. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Dawood Chowrangi - Port Bin Qasim Mor

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Feeder 01: Dawood Chowrangi to Port Bin Qasim Mor via Landhi Road and the N-5. About 9.9 km with 15 bus stops (names not given). Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Dawood Chowrangi - Qasim Road / Mehran Highway intersection

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Feeder 02B: Dawood Chowrangi to the Qasim Road / Mehran Highway intersection via the Landhi industrial area road and Mehran Highway. About 11 km with 18 bus stops (names not given); shares 3.4 km with Feeder 02A, which the EIA does not describe. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.

routes.name: Jinnah Airport Intersection - Murtaza Chowrangi

sources.title: BRT Yellow Line EIA Vol 1 (19 Mar 2024), sec 3.5.7 Direct and Feeder Services

routes.notes: Feeder 03: Jinnah Airport Intersection to Murtaza Chowrangi via Airport Road, Jinnah Terminal Road, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Korangi-Shah Faisal Road, Malir River Bridge and 8000 Road. About 11.8 km with 11 bus stops (names not given); 2.2 km overlaps the BRT corridor. Stops are the two terminals only. Planned in the 2024 EIA service plan; not known to be running.
